title: K-EXAONE Technical Report Journey to Frontier-Level Performance of Foundation Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a detailed, multi-page ethical framework, the Korea-Augmented Universal Taxonomy (K-AUT), and an associated benchmark, the Korean Global Civic Safety Benchmark (KGC-SAFETY). This framework is a core part of the paper's contribution and is used to systematically evaluate the model on ethical principles and sociocultural contexts, which goes far beyond a standard limitations or ethics section.
